# Simplicio Mapper LLM guide

Canonical instructions: AGENTS.md
Claude mirror: CLAUDE.md
Gemini mirror: GEMINI.md
Command and feature index: docs/CLI_COMMANDS.md

Identity
--------
`simplicio-mapper` observes a repository and emits bounded, versioned context
artifacts under `.simplicio/`. It supports mapping, incremental refresh,
task-aware handoff/orientation, graph queries, impact/test analysis, endpoint
and screen inventories, flowcharts, business-rule extraction, history/diffs,
contract validation, canonical-map checks, Mapper-to-Fast handoff and release
metadata. It is not an LLM, policy authority or source editor.

Entry points
------------
`simplicio-mapper --help`
`llm-project-mapper --help`
`node bin/cli.js --help`
`build-hamt-catalog --help`
`apply-edits --help`
`skillopt --help`

Command rule
------------
Every public command and subcommand has `--help`/`-h`. Read help at the level
being invoked before execution: `simplicio-mapper <command> --help`. The full
inventory and routed command families are in `docs/CLI_COMMANDS.md`.

Safety
------
Use `--json` for automation when available. Preserve `schema`, reject unknown
major schema versions, treat unverified facts as unverified, and never apply
source edits from stale context. Use Dev CLI for edits, Fast for snapshot and
PlanDAG work, Runtime for authorization and Loop for convergence.
